news_summary: AMD reported record Q2 2026 results on Aug 4, 2026: revenue of $11.5B (+50% YoY), with Data Center segment revenue of $6.7B more than doubling YoY (+107%) to 58% of total revenue, and non-GAAP diluted EPS of $1.66. Alongside the print, AMD announced a multiyear deal with Anthropic to deploy up to 2 gigawatts of Instinct MI450 Series GPUs in AMD Helios rack-scale systems, plus an expanded Microsoft Azure collaboration. AMD guided Q3 2026 revenue to roughly $13.0B (+/-$300M). Its next earnings date (Q3 2026) is not yet officially confirmed by AMD but third-party trackers place it around Nov 3, 2026. On the regulatory side, AMD's MI350X was named alongside Nvidia chips in Commerce Department guidance (issued around May 31, 2026) tightening export-license requirements for China-headquartered entities routing purchases through offshore subsidiaries.

catalysts.what: AMD reported record Q2 2026 revenue of $11.5B (+50% YoY), with Data Center segment revenue of $6.7B (+107% YoY, 58% of total revenue); GAAP diluted EPS $1.38, non-GAAP diluted EPS $1.66.
AMD guided Q3 2026 revenue to approximately $13.0B (+/-$300M), roughly 41% YoY growth, with non-GAAP gross margin of about 56%.

AMD and Anthropic announced a multiyear strategic collaboration to deploy up to 2 gigawatts of AMD Instinct MI450 Series GPUs in AMD Helios rack-scale systems, alongside an expanded Microsoft Azure deployment of Helios racks and 6th Gen EPYC CPUs.
Third-party earnings trackers list AMD's Q3 2026 results as expected around Nov 3, 2026 after market close, but explicitly flag the date as unconfirmed pending an official AMD announcement.

AMD's MI350X was named alongside Nvidia's Rubin/Blackwell chips in new US Commerce Department guidance enforcing export-license requirements for shipments to China-headquartered entities, even via subsidiaries located outside mainland China.

move_thesis: AMD has been moving on accelerating AI Data Center demand -- record Q2 2026 revenue with Data Center segment more than doubling YoY, a $13B Q3 guide, and marquee capacity commitments (Anthropic's up-to-2GW MI450/Helios deal, expanded Microsoft Azure deployment) that management says position the business for data-center revenue to more than double YoY in 2027. Near-term, the stock has no confirmed next earnings catalyst on AMD's own IR site yet (third-party trackers estimate Nov 3, 2026 for Q3), so the market is trading forward on the Helios/MI450 ramp narrative and second-half guidance while watching for further clarity on China export-license exposure (MI350X) alongside Nvidia's chips.

sources.publication_time_unknown_rationale: Continuously-updated earnings-calendar aggregator page with no article dateline; the page itself flags the Nov 3, 2026 date as unconfirmed.
